answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops sybil farming. Claiming one work slot — a vertex in the task graph — requires burning 50 POA, gone forever, no refund on exit. Each vertex carries a public umber seal, so duplicates show at a glance. Forging 1,000 identities burns 50,000 POA for one epoch's reward of about 200 POA: a loss before the first job. Honest agents pay once and earn from the slot for 20 epochs, with earnings returning at a glacier pace.
